fact: Orange Liberia opened its US$10 million ICON 16 headquarters in Monrovia on 15 May 2025 and pledged a further US$200 million over six years, saying it had invested over US$250 million in its infrastructure since 2016.
title: Orange-Liberia to Inaugurate US$10M ICON-16 Building Today -Calls it Embodiment of Vision Anchored in Liberia's Future
